description: Operational tool entry points; launch definitions are canonical here. docs/TOOL_REGISTRY.md owns usage and evidence limits.

tools.title: Updated upstream REA 6.7.0
tools.effects: Command-dependent; static analysis writes temporary projects. Setup/update/runtime capture require their own scope.
tools.note: Upstream revision 6d356b84344659085f2b912857b5e27fe0160c9b, built locally; no pinned-launcher patch. The old route remains rea-pinned.

tools.title: Preserved patched REA 6.4.0
tools.effects: Command-dependent; static analysis writes temporary projects. Setup/update/runtime capture require their own scope.
tools.note: Historical bounded native route; -noanalysis -max-cpu 2 patch retained. Use explicit ID when its exact analysis identity matters.

tools.title: Direct Ghidra headless
tools.effects: Creates/modifies analysis projects according to supplied flags; preserve repaired projects.

tools.title: ILSpy CLI
tools.effects: Reads assemblies; exports write to caller-selected destinations.

tools.title: Python with UnityPy
tools.effects: Python interpreter for caller-supplied extraction scripts; no extraction performed by launcher.

tools.title: Verified Cpp2IL prerelease 21
tools.note: Complete release hash verified and private executable ad-hoc signed. The old cached file was an exact truncated prefix and is preserved. See cpp2il repair receipt.
tools.effects: Writes recovered metadata/code artifacts. No recovery-quality probe configured.

tools.title: Cached Il2CppDumper
tools.effects: Writes recovery output; supply explicit input/build/output paths. No interactive probe.

tools.title: Offline Discord evidence CLI
tools.effects: Offline import/snapshot/catalog/gallery commands write their explicit output; verify/search read.

tools.title: Local Discord collector web host
tools.effects: Starts loopback service, default port 8787. Use one collector at a time and manual sign-in; set REFERENCE_SCOPE explicitly when changing source.

tools.title: Local Discord collector desktop
tools.effects: Opens desktop collector; local state can persist, credentials do not. Manual sign-in. Human/live export gate remains separate.

tools.title: Isolated polite Fanqie CLI
tools.effects: Acquisition makes network requests and private cache/receipt writes. Reuse existing transport data/refusal owner and matching font.

tools.title: Book search/acquisition CLI
tools.effects: Command-dependent remote/account/acquisition behavior. Read profile before use; no credentials on command line.

tools.title: Source Library unified MCP (legacy launcher)
tools.effects: Starts the 25-tool Source Library stdio server; not MCP registration. Seven unified catalogue/provider tools plus eighteen compatibility research tools. Use platform_download for shared deduplication.

tools.title: Local EPUB intake
tools.effects: Writes prepared private edition and receipt. CLI destination must be selected under ignored research.

tools.title: Calibre database CLI
tools.effects: Command-dependent library writes. Prefer read-only discovery; source library stays unchanged unless requested.

tools.title: Isolated PDF to Markdown
tools.effects: Writes Markdown beside input by default; use -o with an explicit private output folder.

tools.title: pdftotext
tools.effects: Writes extracted text to selected destination.

tools.title: tesseract
tools.effects: Writes OCR output.

tools.title: ffmpeg
tools.effects: Writes converted media; preserve originals.

tools.title: Chrome gameplay playtest
tools.effects: Builds temporary bundle and starts fresh origin/Chrome; private screenshots can contain sealed text.

tools.title: Full-game Node benchmark
tools.effects: Boots game in Node; synthetic/frozen time, no layout proof.

tools.title: Deterministic engine replay
tools.effects: Writes selected recordings/results; engine adapter excludes native publication.

tools.title: Engine invariant fuzzer
tools.effects: Default is substantial work and writes reports; choose bounded seeds/workers/output.

tools.title: Browser/engine performance gate
tools.effects: Build/Chrome workloads; reads budgets and selected revision inputs.

tools.title: Shared-machine suite/browser queue
tools.effects: Creates queue bookkeeping and runs the supplied command.

tools.title: REA upstream source and built runtime
tools.note: Updated, built 6.7.0; use rea for execution and rea-pinned for the historical patched route.

tools.title: Discrub and DiscordChatExporter
tools.note: Import adapters available; live exporter installation/authentication must be verified.

tools.title: Saved reference corpora
tools.note: Resolve exact build/edition/receipt first. Availability is per path, not entire root.

tools.title: Signed-in browser and web research
tools.note: Discover session browser tools; use connected service tools where sufficient. No native-computer API in audited CUA session.

tools.title: Drive, mail, calendar and other connectors
tools.note: Discover current session capabilities; declarations do not prove authentication or send authority.

tools.title: Image generation, Blender and document artifacts
tools.note: Use matching skills/current session tools. No live Blender verification recorded.

tools.title: Interactive UI comparison workbench
tools.note: Use current recipe and 1920x1080 target; candidate proof is separate from acceptance.

tools.title: TrustMRR product scout
tools.note: Explicit scope and credential required; not whole-market discovery.

tools.title: Video angle/center measurement
tools.note: Client-side tool; calibrate real measurement accuracy.

tools.title: Visible Vimeo transcript extraction
tools.note: Requires source transcript UI and full cue-boundary verification.

tools.title: Unified Source Library app API and JSON CLI
tools.effects: Command-dependent local indexing, source search and explicit selected transfers. Data/credentials stay in private source-platform root. CLI status probes configured local services.

tools.title: Source Library local service controller
tools.effects: Explicit start/stop of task-owned Suwayomi, Komga, CLU and local app services; start can claim an unclaimed local Komga install.

tools.title: Rebuild pinned source platform runtimes and native app
tools.effects: Explicit installation/rebuild: hash-verified pinned service downloads, separate CLU checkout/venv and optional native macOS shell. Does not update arbitrary upstream releases.
